name: contradiction-mcp

tools.name: contradiction.health.check
tools.description: Checks the operational status of the Contradiction MCP server, including SQLite database connectivity, storage metrics, active connectors, and runtime diagnostics. Read-only and safe to invoke frequently for readiness and liveness probing.

verbose.description: Whether to include extended diagnostic details such as memory usage, uptime, and connector capabilities (default: false)

tools.name: contradiction.sources.list
tools.description: Lists all registered external data source connectors (document, website, github) and ingested source entities tracked by the system, including source IDs, synchronization timestamps, and claim counts. Read-only operation. Use this tool to inspect available data sources before initiating scans or synchronization.

type.description: Optional filter by source connector type

limit.description: Maximum number of ingested source records to return (default: 50)

tools.name: contradiction.sources.test
tools.description: Validates connectivity, authentication, and accessibility for an external data source or connector (such as a GitHub repository, web URL, or local file) without persisting any data or modifying state. Use this tool to verify credentials and target reachability prior to running synchronization.

connector.description: The connector type to validate (github, website, document)

target.description: Target identifier to validate: "owner/repo" for GitHub, URL for website, or file path for document

branch.description: Optional git branch or tag name to check when testing GitHub repositories

tools.name: contradiction.sources.sync
tools.description: Ingests and synchronizes one or more external data sources (local document file, public website URL, or GitHub repository), extracts factual claims with exact line provenance, idempotently updates SQLite storage, and triggers automatic contradiction discovery. Mutating and idempotent operation. Supports single source ingestion or concurrent batch synchronization.

connector.description: The external source connector to synchronize (document for local files, website for URLs, github for repositories)

source.description: Source locator: absolute/relative file path for document, public URL for website, or "owner/repo" for GitHub

input.description: Structured connector input object (e.g. { filePath: "..." }) for flexible invocation

sourceName.description: Optional human-readable friendly label for the source

subject.description: Subject entity name for extracted claims (defaults to filename or repository name)

environment.description: Target environment context for extracted claims (e.g. "production", "staging", "development")

scope.description: Scope of the document or claims (e.g. "system", "component", "file")

sourceRole.description: Role of the source in system architecture (e.g. "specification", "configuration", "documentation", "deployment")

branch.description: Optional branch or tag name when syncing GitHub repositories

runDiscovery.description: Whether to automatically trigger incremental contradiction discovery on touched claims after sync (default: true)

batch.description: Optional batch array of source requests to synchronize concurrently with failure isolation

tools.name: contradiction.conflicts.scan
tools.description: Discovers conflicting and inconsistent factual assertions across connected sources. Can scan the entire database, or scope the scan to a specific source, file, or single claim. Uses deterministic candidate grouping, entity resolution, and value comparison algorithms to detect and persist contradictions without duplicates. Mutating and idempotent.

sourceId.description: Scope scan to claims originating from a specific source ID, file path, or repository name

claimId.description: Scope scan to a single claim by ID, testing it against all eligible candidate claims

limit.description: Maximum number of contradiction results to return (default: 50)

includeDismissed.description: Whether to include previously dismissed contradictions in output (default: false)

tools.name: contradiction.claims.analyze
tools.description: Performs deep comparative analysis between two factual claims to determine whether they contradict each other. Evaluates semantic meaning, value differences, numeric/temporal ranges, and contextual dimensions (environment divergence, scope, source roles). Returns contradiction classification, severity, confidence score, and detailed explanation. Read-only operation.

claimAId.description: The unique ID of the first claim

claimBId.description: The unique ID of the second claim

explainContext.description: Whether to include detailed contextual relationship dimensions such as SemVer compatibility and role authority (default: true)

tools.name: contradiction.claims.list
tools.description: Queries stored factual assertions and claims extracted from connected sources with flexible filtering by subject, predicate, source, environment, and value type. Read-only operation. Use this tool to explore known facts, find subjects with multiple assertions, or inspect extracted data.

subject.description: Filter by claim subject entity name (e.g. "UserAuthService", "API Gateway")

limit.description: Maximum number of claims to return (default: 50)

tools.name: contradiction.claims.get
tools.description: Retrieves complete details for a single factual claim by ID, including its subject, predicate, current and normalized values, provenance evidence, originating source metadata, and chronological historical value transitions over time. Read-only operation.

claimId.description: The unique ID of the claim to retrieve

includeHistory.description: Whether to include full chronological value transitions and superseded historical values (default: true)

tools.name: contradiction.conflicts.list
tools.description: Queries stored contradiction records from the database with filtering by resolution status, severity level, contradiction type, and confidence score. Returns enriched contradiction records with associated claim summaries and originating source details. Read-only operation. Use this tool to prioritize and triage conflicts.

status.description: Filter by contradiction lifecycle status (OPEN, REVIEWED, RESOLVED, DISMISSED)

severity.description: Filter by severity level (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

type.description: Filter by contradiction classification type string

minConfidence.description: Filter by minimum confidence threshold between 0.0 and 1.0

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 50)

tools.name: contradiction.conflicts.get
tools.description: Retrieves complete details of a single contradiction record by ID, including full representations of both conflicting claims, originating source metadata, exact line evidence snippets, and chronological audit trail of all review and resolution actions. Read-only operation.

contradictionId.description: The unique ID of the contradiction record to retrieve

includeAuditHistory.description: Whether to include the full chronological review and resolution audit trail (default: true)

tools.name: contradiction.conflicts.advise
tools.description: Generates deterministic authority, freshness, and evidence comparison between conflicting claims to advise an AI agent or human reviewer on which claim likely represents current truth and recommended remediation steps. Read-only deterministic calculation.

contradictionId.description: The unique ID of the contradiction record to analyze for resolution advice

tools.name: contradiction.conflicts.resolve
tools.description: Updates the lifecycle status and audit trail of a contradiction record. Supports marking as REVIEWED, resolving as RESOLVED with an authoritative chosen claim, dismissing as DISMISSED (acceptable divergence), or reopening back to OPEN. Preserves an immutable audit trail of reviewer identity, decision reason, and timestamp. Mutating operation.

contradictionId.description: The unique ID of the contradiction record to update

action.description: Lifecycle action to perform: RESOLVE (accepts authoritative claim), REVIEW (marks reviewed), DISMISS (marks acceptable divergence), REOPEN (reopens back to OPEN) (default: RESOLVE)

actor.description: Name, email, or agent identifier performing the lifecycle action (defaults to resolvedBy if provided)

resolvedBy.description: Legacy parameter: Name or identifier of the resolver when action is RESOLVE

reason.description: Detailed explanation justifying the decision (required for RESOLVE and DISMISS)

chosenClaimId.description: ID of the claim accepted as authoritative (optional for RESOLVE action)

notes.description: Additional triage notes or reviewer findings
